blocks.zh: 第九章：運輸
blocks.en: Chapter 9: Transportation

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 掌握運輸過程中的首要責任歸屬 — 供應批發商 (supplying wholesale distributor) 對運輸品質負主要責任
blocks.en: Understand where primary responsibility for transportation lies: the supplying wholesale distributor is primarily responsible for transport quality

blocks.zh: 理解風險導向方法 (risk-based approach) 如何應用於運輸計畫設計，包含路線評估與溫控設備選擇
blocks.en: Understand how the risk-based approach applies to transport planning, including route assessment and selection of temperature-control equipment

blocks.zh: 區分不同容器與包裝的選擇邏輯，及其與產品儲存要求、運輸時間的關聯
blocks.en: Distinguish the logic for selecting containers and packaging, and how it relates to product storage requirements and transit time

blocks.zh: 掌握溫度敏感產品 (temperature-sensitive products) 的特殊運輸要求 — 包含冷媒、保溫箱、溫控車輛的管控細節
blocks.en: Understand the special transport requirements for temperature-sensitive products, including control details for coolants, insulated boxes and temperature-controlled vehicles

blocks.zh: 了解第三方運輸商的管理要求，及中途轉運 (transit) 情境下的特別注意事項
blocks.en: Understand the management requirements for third-party transporters and the special considerations for transit (intermediate transshipment) situations

blocks.zh: 應用至台灣 CDMO 出廠及出口情境：從廠內交貨點到境外的冷鏈完整性管控
blocks.en: Apply the requirements to Taiwan CDMO release and export scenarios: controlling cold chain integrity from the plant's handover point to overseas destinations

blocks.zh: 9.1 Principle — 原則
blocks.en: 9.1 Principle

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念：運輸責任的四個保護面向
blocks.en: Core Concept: Four Protection Aspects of Transport Responsibility

blocks.zh: 9.1.1 的四重保護義務：
blocks.en: The four protection obligations in 9.1.1:

blocks.zh: Breakage（防破損）： 適當的緩衝包裝、搬運限制、易碎品標示
blocks.en: Breakage: appropriate cushioning packaging, handling restrictions, fragile-goods labelling

blocks.zh: Adulteration（防摻偽）： 封箱完整性、產品不得與非藥品混載、清潔車輛
blocks.en: Adulteration: intact box sealing, no co-loading of medicinal products with non-pharmaceutical goods, clean vehicles

blocks.zh: Theft（防盜竊）： 尤其對麻醉藥品、高單價生物製劑，需要安全封存與追蹤
blocks.en: Theft: secure storage and tracking are needed, especially for narcotics and high-value biologics

blocks.zh: Temperature（溫控）： 在整個運輸過程中維持可接受的溫度範圍
blocks.en: Temperature: maintaining an acceptable temperature range throughout transport

blocks.zh: 9.1.2 的「能夠展示」(demonstrate) 要求： 這不只是做到，還要能證明做到。溫度記錄、GPS 追蹤、交接確認文件，都是「展示」的工具。
blocks.en: The "demonstrate" requirement in 9.1.2: It is not enough to do it; you must be able to prove you did it. Temperature records, GPS tracking and handover confirmation documents are all tools for "demonstrating".

blocks.zh: Risk-based approach（風險導向方法）： 運輸計畫不是一刀切。不同產品（常溫 vs. 冷藏 vs. 冷凍）、不同路線（城市配送 vs. 跨境出口）、不同季節（台灣夏季高溫 vs. 冬季），風險層級不同，所需的管控措施也不同。
blocks.en: Risk-based approach: A transport plan is not one-size-fits-all. Different products (ambient vs. refrigerated vs. frozen), different routes (urban delivery vs. cross-border export) and different seasons (Taiwan's hot summer vs. winter) carry different levels of risk, so the controls needed also differ.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 想像你用快遞寄送鮮奶油蛋糕（冷藏藥品）。你（supplying distributor）有責任確保蛋糕到達時仍是完好且冷的，不能只說「我交給快遞了，剩下的與我無關」。「Risk-based approach」就像你在選擇快遞方式時會考量：距離遠近、天氣溫度、收件人有無冷藏設備、蛋糕有多精緻（貴重程度）。根據這些因素，你會選擇隔日冷藏快遞，還是普通常溫配送，或是自己開車送？
blocks.en: Imagine you are sending a fresh cream cake (a refrigerated medicine) by courier. You (the supplying distributor) are responsible for making sure the cake arrives intact and cold; you cannot just say, "I handed it to the courier, the rest is not my concern." A "risk-based approach" is like choosing a delivery method by considering the distance, the weather, whether the recipient has a refrigerator, and how delicate (valuable) the cake is. Based on these factors, would you choose next-day refrigerated courier, ordinary ambient delivery, or drive it there yourself?

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Note
blocks.en: Key Note

blocks.zh: 「Supplying wholesale distributor」的責任起點： 注意，責任在「供應端的批發配送商」，而非「接收端」。對台灣 CDMO 而言，一旦產品從倉庫發出，在交付給客戶前的整個運輸過程，你仍是主要責任方（即使你委託了第三方物流）。這與第 7 章的委外責任邏輯一致。
blocks.en: Where the responsibility of the "supplying wholesale distributor" begins: Note that responsibility lies with the supplying wholesale distributor, not the receiving side. For a Taiwan CDMO, once the product leaves the warehouse, you remain the primary responsible party for the entire transport until it is delivered to the customer (even if you have contracted a third-party logistics provider). This is consistent with the outsourcing responsibility logic in Chapter 7.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 台灣夏季氣溫高達 35°C，對一個儲存條件為「室溫 15–25°C」的藥品，在規劃配送路線時需要考量哪些風險因素？
blocks.en: Taiwan's summer temperatures reach 35°C. For a medicine with a storage condition of "room temperature 15–25°C", what risk factors must be considered when planning the delivery route?

blocks.zh: 若客戶要求自行安排物流來 CDMO 廠區取貨，CDMO 在交貨後是否還有運輸責任？責任如何移轉？
blocks.en: If a customer asks to arrange their own logistics to collect goods from the CDMO site, does the CDMO still have transport responsibility after handover? How is responsibility transferred?

blocks.zh: 9.2 Transportation — 運輸管理
blocks.en: 9.2 Transportation

blocks.zh: 核心概念：運輸管理的十個面向
blocks.en: Core Concept: Ten Aspects of Transport Management

blocks.zh: 儲存條件的延伸（9.2.1）： 外包裝標示的儲存條件（如「2–8°C」「15–25°C」）在整個運輸過程中同樣有效。這個要求看似基本，但在實際操作中常被忽略 — 裝卸貨過程、車輛停等紅燈時的門開啟、最後一哩路的非溫控搬運，都可能導致條件突破。
blocks.en: Extension of storage conditions (9.2.1): The storage conditions stated on the outer packaging (such as "2–8°C" or "15–25°C") remain valid throughout transport. This requirement seems basic but is often overlooked in practice: loading and unloading, the door being opened at traffic lights, and non-temperature-controlled handling on the last mile can all cause an excursion.

blocks.zh: 車輛設備責任（9.2.3-9.2.4）： 批發商必須確認所用車輛和設備「適合其用途」，並有書面的操作、維護、清潔程序。這包含自有車輛和租用車輛。
blocks.en: Responsibility for vehicles and equipment (9.2.3-9.2.4): The distributor must confirm that the vehicles and equipment used are "suitable for their purpose" and have written procedures for operation, maintenance and cleaning. This covers both owned and rented vehicles.

blocks.zh: 路線風險評估（9.2.5）： 並非所有路線都需要相同程度的溫控。風險評估的變數包含：距離、氣候、季節、產品敏感性、交通狀況（台灣高速公路壅塞可能導致車廂溫度上升）。
blocks.en: Route risk assessment (9.2.5): Not every route needs the same degree of temperature control. Variables in the risk assessment include distance, climate, season, product sensitivity and traffic conditions (congestion on Taiwan's expressways can raise the temperature in the cargo compartment).

blocks.zh: 專用 vs. 非專用設備（9.2.6）： 若使用非專用車輛（如同時運送非藥品貨物），必須有書面程序確保產品品質不受影響，例如隔離要求、清潔確認、交叉污染排除程序。
blocks.en: Dedicated vs. non-dedicated equipment (9.2.6): If non-dedicated vehicles are used (for example, also carrying non-pharmaceutical goods), there must be written procedures ensuring product quality is not affected, such as segregation requirements, cleaning verification and procedures to exclude cross-contamination.

blocks.zh: 9.2.7 要求「必須送到配送單上的地址，交到收件人手中，不得留置於替代地點」。這就像網路購物的生鮮配送 — 冷凍食品不能直接放在你家門口（夏天會融化），必須確認有人收件，或留置在指定冷藏收件箱中。藥品配送更嚴格：任何未按指定地點/人員交接的行為，都是 GDP 缺失，因為無法確認產品在「替代地點」的保管條件。
blocks.en: 9.2.7 requires that the product "must be delivered to the address stated on the delivery note and placed into the hands of the recipient, and not left at alternative premises". This is like fresh-food delivery from an online shop: frozen food cannot simply be left on your doorstep (it would melt in summer); someone must confirm receipt, or it must be left in a designated refrigerated receiving box. Medicine delivery is stricter: any handover not made to the designated place or person is a GDP failure, because the storage conditions at the "alternative location" cannot be confirmed.

blocks.zh: 溫度偏差的雙向通報義務（9.2.2）： 發生溫度偏差時，必須通報兩個對象：(1) 負責配送的批發商；(2) 受影響產品的收件人。為什麼兩個都要通報？因為收件人（如醫院藥局）需要決定是否能使用受影響的批次，而配送商需要調查問題根源。
blocks.en: Two-way notification of temperature excursions (9.2.2): When a temperature excursion occurs, two parties must be notified: (1) the distributor responsible for the delivery; and (2) the recipient of the affected products. Why both? The recipient (such as a hospital pharmacy) needs to decide whether the affected batch can be used, while the distributor needs to investigate the root cause.

blocks.zh: 緊急配送的書面程序（9.2.8）： 緊急情況（如重症患者急需用藥，深夜配送）在正常程序外運作，反而更容易出錯。必須有指定的值班人員清單和書面程序，確保緊急情況下也能符合 GDP。
blocks.en: Written procedures for emergency deliveries (9.2.8): Emergencies (for example, a critically ill patient urgently needing medicine, with delivery late at night) operate outside normal procedures and are therefore more error-prone. There must be a list of designated on-call personnel and written procedures to ensure GDP compliance in emergencies as well.

blocks.zh: 中途轉運的特別風險（9.2.9）： 國際出口貨物常需在轉運港（如香港、新加坡）轉機/換船，中途在倉庫暫存的時段是溫度管控最脆弱的環節。運輸合約必須明確規定中途轉運設施的溫控和安全要求。
blocks.en: Special risks of transit (9.2.9): Exported international shipments often have to be transferred by air or sea at transit hubs (such as Hong Kong or Singapore), and the period of interim storage in a warehouse is the most vulnerable point for temperature control. The transport contract must clearly specify the temperature control and security requirements for transit facilities.

blocks.zh: 最小化等待時間（9.2.10）： 產品在轉運點暫存的時間越長，風險越高。這要求在規劃運輸時就要考量時間緩衝，避免貨物在非溫控環境下長時間等待。
blocks.en: Minimizing waiting time (9.2.10): The longer a product is held at a transit point, the higher the risk. Time buffers must therefore be considered when planning transport, to avoid goods waiting for long periods in a non-temperature-controlled environment.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: 情境：你的 CDMO 需要將一批 2–8°C 的無菌注射劑從台灣新竹廠出口至日本，路徑為：廠房 → 桃園機場（冷藏卡車，約 1.5 小時）→ 機場冷藏倉（等待清關，約 4 小時）→ 飛機貨艙（飛行約 3 小時）→ 成田機場中轉（約 2 小時）→ 客戶倉庫（冷藏貨車，約 2 小時）。
blocks.en: Scenario: Your CDMO needs to export a batch of 2–8°C sterile injectables from its Hsinchu plant in Taiwan to Japan. The route is: plant → Taoyuan Airport (refrigerated truck, about 1.5 hours) → airport cold store (awaiting customs clearance, about 4 hours) → aircraft hold (flight of about 3 hours) → Narita Airport transit (about 2 hours) → customer warehouse (refrigerated truck, about 2 hours).

blocks.zh: 依 9.2 要求，你需要確認：
blocks.en: Under 9.2, you need to confirm:

blocks.zh: 9.2.1： 每個環節的溫度維持在 2–8°C — 哪些環節是風險最高的？（答：機場等待清關、中轉倉）
blocks.en: 9.2.1: Is the temperature maintained at 2–8°C at every stage? Which stages carry the highest risk? (Answer: waiting at the airport for customs clearance, and the transit warehouse)

blocks.zh: 9.2.5： 溫度記錄儀放置在哪裡？如何覆蓋全程（含飛機貨艙）？
blocks.en: 9.2.5: Where are the temperature data loggers placed? How is the whole journey covered (including the aircraft hold)?

blocks.zh: 9.2.9： 與航空貨運公司的合約是否包含第 7 章要求？機場清關等待期間的冷藏設施是否符合 GDP？
blocks.en: 9.2.9: Does the contract with the air freight company include the Chapter 7 requirements? Do the cold storage facilities used during airport customs waiting comply with GDP?

blocks.zh: 9.2.10： 航班時間是否已最小化在機場等待的時間？若延誤超過保溫時限，備案計畫是什麼？
blocks.en: 9.2.10: Has the flight schedule minimized the waiting time at the airport? If a delay exceeds the insulation holding time, what is the contingency plan?

blocks.zh: 你的物流商使用同一輛貨車同時配送藥品和食品補充劑（非藥品）。在 9.2.6 的要求下，你需要要求物流商提供哪些文件或程序？
blocks.en: Your logistics provider uses the same truck to deliver both medicines and food supplements (non-medicinal products). Under 9.2.6, what documents or procedures should you require from the provider?

blocks.zh: 配送時發現客戶倉庫今天沒有人收貨。司機不能把藥品留在門口，那正確的處置程序應該是什麼？依據哪條 GDP 要求？
blocks.en: On delivery, you find that nobody is receiving goods at the customer's warehouse today. The driver cannot leave the medicines at the door; what is the correct procedure, and under which GDP requirement?

blocks.zh: 台灣某家醫院在半夜急需你廠的某支急救藥品。你的緊急配送 SOP 應包含哪些要素，才能在非上班時間也能符合 GDP？
blocks.en: A hospital in Taiwan urgently needs an emergency medicine from your plant in the middle of the night. What elements should your emergency delivery SOP include so that it complies with GDP outside working hours?

blocks.zh: 9.3 Containers, Packaging and Labelling — 容器、包裝與標示
blocks.en: 9.3 Containers, Packaging and Labelling

blocks.zh: 核心概念：容器選擇的六個考量因素（9.3.2）
blocks.en: Core Concept: Six Factors in Container Selection (9.3.2)

blocks.zh: 9.3.2 列出了六個容器選擇的評估維度，這是 GDP 中少見的「明確清單」，值得逐條掌握：
blocks.en: 9.3.2 lists six evaluation dimensions for container selection. This is a rare "explicit list" in GDP and is worth mastering item by item:

blocks.zh: 儲存和運輸要求： 產品本身的溫度、光照、濕度要求（外包裝上的標示）
blocks.en: Storage and transport requirements: the product's own temperature, light and humidity requirements (as stated on the outer packaging)

blocks.zh: 藥品數量： 所需空間大小影響容器尺寸選擇
blocks.en: Quantity of medicines: the space required affects the choice of container size

blocks.zh: 預期外部溫度極值： 台灣夏季最高氣溫（可達 38°C）是設計保溫系統的關鍵輸入
blocks.en: Expected external temperature extremes: Taiwan's maximum summer temperature (up to 38°C) is a key input for designing the insulation system

blocks.zh: 最大運輸時間（含清關等待）： 這決定了保溫箱/冷媒的設計時長（保護期限）
blocks.en: Maximum transit time (including customs waiting): this determines the design duration (protection period) of the insulated box and coolants

blocks.zh: 包裝的 Qualification 狀態： 包裝材料是否經過資格驗證（qualification）？
blocks.en: Qualification status of the packaging: Has the packaging material been qualified?

blocks.zh: 運輸容器的 Validation 狀態： 保溫箱/溫控貨櫃是否經過驗證，確認在特定條件下能維持目標溫度？
blocks.en: Validation status of the transport container: Has the insulated box or temperature-controlled container been validated to confirm it maintains the target temperature under specified conditions?

blocks.zh: 選擇藥品運輸容器就像設計一個極地探險的背包。你不能拿一般的城市後背包就去南極 — 你需要根據：探險地的最低溫度（外部溫度極值）、探險天數（最大運輸時間）、要帶的物品清單（藥品數量與要求）來選擇材質、保暖層數、防水設計。且在出發前，這個背包要在實驗室測試過（verification/qualification），確認在模擬南極條件下能維持內部溫暖（驗證）。
blocks.en: Choosing a container for medicine transport is like designing a backpack for a polar expedition. You cannot take an ordinary city backpack to Antarctica; you choose the material, insulation layers and waterproofing based on the lowest temperature at the destination (external temperature extremes), the number of days (maximum transit time) and the list of items to carry (quantity and requirements of the medicines). And before departure, the backpack must be tested in a laboratory (verification/qualification) to confirm that it keeps the inside warm under simulated Antarctic conditions (validation).

blocks.zh: Qualification vs. Validation 的細微差異： 9.3.2 區分了包裝的「qualification status」和運輸容器的「validation status」。在 GDP/GMP 用語中：
blocks.en: The subtle difference between qualification and validation: 9.3.2 distinguishes the "qualification status" of packaging from the "validation status" of transport containers. In GDP/GMP terminology:

blocks.zh: Qualification（資格確認）： 確認設備或系統設計正確、已安裝正確、在靜態條件下運作正確（DQ/IQ/OQ）
blocks.en: Qualification: confirming that equipment or a system is correctly designed, correctly installed and operates correctly under static conditions (DQ/IQ/OQ)

blocks.zh: Validation（驗證）： 確認在實際使用條件下能持續達到預期結果（PQ）
blocks.en: Validation: confirming that the intended results are consistently achieved under actual conditions of use (PQ)

blocks.zh: 保溫箱的 validation 通常包含：在最壞情況下（夏季最高環境溫度、最長預期運輸時間）的溫度分布測試，確認箱內各點溫度均維持在 2–8°C（或其他目標範圍）。這份報告在客戶稽核和監管查廠時都可能被要求提示。
blocks.en: Validation of an insulated box normally includes a temperature distribution test under worst-case conditions (highest summer ambient temperature, longest expected transit time), confirming that all points inside the box stay within 2–8°C (or another target range). This report may be requested during customer audits and regulatory inspections.

blocks.zh: 標示的「識別功能」（9.3.3）： 容器標示必須同時滿足：(1) 搬運指示（How to handle）；(2) 內容識別（What's inside）；(3) 來源識別（Where it's from）。若容器外部只有「易碎」標示而沒有批次號或藥廠名稱，不符合 9.3.3 的要求。
blocks.en: The "identification function" of labelling (9.3.3): Container labels must satisfy all of the following: (1) handling instructions (how to handle); (2) identification of contents (what's inside); (3) identification of origin (where it's from). If the outside of a container only has a "fragile" mark but no batch number or manufacturer name, it does not meet the requirements of 9.3.3.

blocks.zh: 你的 CDMO 要為一個 2–8°C 生物製劑的出口運輸設計保溫箱系統。根據 9.3.2 的六個因素，你需要在規格書中記錄：
blocks.en: Your CDMO is to design an insulated box system for the export of a 2–8°C biologic. Based on the six factors in 9.3.2, what should you record in the specification?

blocks.zh: 外部溫度極值： 夏季桃園機場最高環境溫度 38°C（實測數據或氣象局歷史資料）
blocks.en: External temperature extremes: maximum summer ambient temperature at Taoyuan Airport of 38°C (measured data or historical data from the weather bureau)

blocks.zh: 最大運輸時間： 廠房到日本客戶倉庫的最長情境（含延誤：廠 1.5h + 機場等待 8h + 飛行 4h + 中轉 3h + 配送 2h = 18.5 小時緩衝設計）
blocks.en: Maximum transit time: the longest scenario from the plant to the customer's warehouse in Japan, including delays (plant 1.5 h + airport wait 8 h + flight 4 h + transit 3 h + delivery 2 h = a design buffer of 18.5 hours)

blocks.zh: 驗證報告： 保溫箱在 38°C 環境下能維持 2–8°C 超過 24 小時的實測數據
blocks.en: Validation report: measured data showing that the insulated box maintains 2–8°C for more than 24 hours at an ambient temperature of 38°C

blocks.zh: 季節設定： 夏季設定（少冷媒）vs. 冬季設定（防止過凍）必須分別驗證
blocks.en: Seasonal configurations: the summer configuration (less coolant) and the winter configuration (to prevent freezing) must each be validated separately

blocks.zh: 你的客戶要求你使用他們提供的保溫箱。如果對方無法提供這個保溫箱的 validation 報告，你應如何回應以符合 GDP 要求？
blocks.en: Your customer asks you to use an insulated box that they supply. If they cannot provide a validation report for this box, how should you respond to remain compliant with GDP?

blocks.zh: 一個僅標示「FRAGILE — 易碎」和收件人地址的運輸箱，是否符合 9.3.3 的標示要求？缺少什麼？
blocks.en: Does a shipping box labelled only "FRAGILE" and the recipient's address meet the labelling requirements of 9.3.3? What is missing?

blocks.zh: 若夏季和冬季的保溫箱設定（冷媒數量/配置）不同，應如何管理以確保倉儲人員不會在冬天誤用夏季設定？
blocks.en: If the summer and winter insulated box configurations (coolant quantity/arrangement) differ, how should they be managed so that warehouse staff do not mistakenly use the summer configuration in winter?

blocks.zh: 9.4 Products Requiring Controlled Conditions — 需特殊條件的產品
blocks.en: 9.4 Products Requiring Controlled Conditions

blocks.zh: 核心概念：特殊管控產品的三類分層
blocks.en: Core Concept: Three Tiers of Specially Controlled Products

blocks.zh: 9.4 針對三類特殊產品提供了分層要求：
blocks.en: 9.4 provides tiered requirements for three categories of special products:

blocks.zh: 麻藥/精神藥品（9.4.1）： 除 GDP 要求外，還須遵循國家法規的額外管控（台灣的《管制藥品管理條例》）；必須有防盜應對方案
blocks.en: Narcotic and psychotropic substances (9.4.1): In addition to GDP requirements, the extra controls of national legislation must be followed (in Taiwan, the Controlled Drugs Act); an anti-theft response plan is required

blocks.zh: 高活性及放射性物質（9.4.2）： 必須使用專用安全容器與車輛；符合國際協議（如 IAEA 放射性物質運輸規範）
blocks.en: Highly active and radioactive materials (9.4.2): dedicated, safe and secure containers and vehicles must be used; compliance with international agreements (such as the IAEA regulations for the transport of radioactive material) is required

blocks.zh: 溫度敏感產品（9.4.3-9.4.8）： 最多規定，也是 CDMO 無菌製劑最常遇到的情境 — 重點在「qualified equipment」、溫度 mapping、冷媒管理
blocks.en: Temperature-sensitive products (9.4.3-9.4.8): the most heavily specified category and the scenario CDMOs handling sterile products meet most often; the focus is on qualified equipment, temperature mapping and coolant management

blocks.zh: Qualified equipment（9.4.3）的重要性： 必須使用「已資格確認」的設備 — 這意味著在正式使用前，溫控車輛或保溫容器需要完成 qualification 研究，確認其在規定條件下能維持目標溫度範圍。
blocks.en: The importance of qualified equipment (9.4.3): Qualified equipment must be used. This means that before routine use, temperature-controlled vehicles or insulated containers need to complete a qualification study confirming that they maintain the target temperature range under specified conditions.

blocks.zh: 冷媒的管理（9.4.6-9.4.7）有個直觀的比喻：想像你用冰塊保存海鮮。如果冰塊沒有完全結冰（incompletely cooled pack）就拿來用，保冷效果會大打折扣，海鮮可能在抵達前就壞掉。9.4.6 說「產品不能直接接觸冷媒」，就像你不能讓魚直接貼著不夠冷的冰塊 — 一方面冰可能不夠冷，另一方面「過冷」的冷媒可能讓產品結凍（對 2–8°C 產品是嚴重問題）。季節設定的培訓（seasonal configurations training）就像告訴員工：夏天和冬天裝冰箱的方式不一樣。
blocks.en: Coolant management (9.4.6-9.4.7) has an intuitive analogy: imagine keeping seafood on ice. If the ice is not fully frozen (an incompletely cooled pack) when used, the cooling effect is greatly reduced and the seafood may spoil before arrival. 9.4.6 says "products must not be in direct contact with coolants", just as you would not let fish lie directly against ice that is not cold enough; on the one hand the ice may not be cold enough, and on the other hand an "overcooled" coolant may freeze the product (a serious problem for 2–8°C products). Training on seasonal configurations is like telling staff that the way to pack a refrigerator differs between summer and winter.

blocks.zh: 溫度 mapping 的季節性要求（9.4.4）： 溫控車輛的 temperature mapping（溫度分布研究）必須考量「季節變化」。台灣夏季與冬季的環境溫差可達 20°C 以上，車廂內的溫度分布在不同季節下可能截然不同。合規的 mapping 至少應包含：夏季（7–9月，最高溫情境）和冬季（1–2月，最低溫情境）各一次，或以模擬最壞情況的方式覆蓋全年溫度範圍。
blocks.en: Seasonal requirements for temperature mapping (9.4.4): Temperature mapping (a temperature distribution study) of temperature-controlled vehicles must take "seasonal variations" into account. Ambient temperature differences between summer and winter in Taiwan can exceed 20°C, and the temperature distribution inside the cargo compartment can be quite different in different seasons. Compliant mapping should include at least one study in summer (July-September, the highest-temperature scenario) and one in winter (January-February, the lowest-temperature scenario), or cover the full-year temperature range by simulating the worst case.

blocks.zh: 溫度記錄的客戶提供義務（9.4.5）： 「if requested」代表客戶有權要求你提供運輸過程的溫度合規記錄。這意味著你必須保存完整的溫度記錄，且記錄格式必須可以向客戶清楚說明。建議在標準交貨文件中主動附上簡要的溫度合規確認，並在合約中明確記錄保存期限。
blocks.en: Obligation to provide temperature records to customers (9.4.5): "If requested" means the customer has the right to ask you for the temperature compliance records of the transport. This means you must retain complete temperature records, and the record format must be clearly explainable to the customer. It is advisable to proactively attach a brief temperature compliance confirmation to the standard delivery documents and to specify the retention period clearly in the contract.

blocks.zh: 冷媒的「不完全冷卻」風險（9.4.7）： 這是實務中最容易被忽略的細節。重複使用的冷媒若未完全重新冷凍，看起來是固體但實際上中心已融化，保冷能力遠低於標準。必須建立系統（如顏色標記、重量確認、或回收後最短冷凍時間規定）來防止這個問題。
blocks.en: The risk of "incompletely cooled" coolants (9.4.7): This is the detail most easily overlooked in practice. If reused coolant has not been completely re-frozen, it may look solid but have a melted core, with cooling capacity far below the standard. A system (such as colour coding, weight checks or a defined minimum freezing time after return) must be established to prevent this.

blocks.zh: 客戶在收貨後要求你提供這批貨運輸過程的完整溫度記錄。你的溫度記錄儀資料顯示有一段 45 分鐘的數據空白（設備故障）。你如何處理這個情況？
blocks.en: After receiving the goods, a customer asks you for the complete temperature records of the shipment. Your data logger data shows a 45-minute data gap (equipment failure). How do you handle this?

blocks.zh: 你的倉儲員工認為「只要冷媒還是硬的就可以用」。為什麼這個判斷方式是不夠的？根據 9.4.7，應建立什麼更嚴格的標準？
blocks.en: Your warehouse staff believe that "coolants can be used as long as they are still hard". Why is this criterion insufficient? Under 9.4.7, what stricter standard should be established?

blocks.zh: 你的 CDMO 接到一個承接麻藥（管制藥品）的冷藏倉儲委外業務。除了 GDP 的溫控要求，還需要符合哪些台灣法規要求（至少說出兩項）？
blocks.en: Your CDMO receives an outsourced job for refrigerated storage of narcotics (controlled drugs). In addition to GDP temperature control requirements, which Taiwan regulatory requirements must be met (name at least two)?

blocks.zh: 你的 CDMO 使用保溫箱（insulated box）搭配冷媒（cool pack）配送 2–8°C 生物製劑。根據 9.4.6-9.4.8，你需要建立以下管控機制：
blocks.en: Your CDMO uses insulated boxes with cool packs to deliver 2–8°C biologics. Based on 9.4.6-9.4.8, you need to establish the following control mechanisms:

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 責任歸屬： 供應批發商 (supplying wholesale distributor) 是運輸品質的主要責任方，委外給第三方物流不免除此責任
blocks.en: Responsibility: The supplying wholesale distributor is the primary responsible party for transport quality; outsourcing to a third-party logistics provider does not remove this responsibility

blocks.zh: 能夠展示原則： 不只要「做到」，還要能「證明做到」— 溫度記錄、校正紀錄、交接文件是關鍵證據
blocks.en: The "demonstrate" principle: It is not enough to do it; you must be able to prove it. Temperature records, calibration records and handover documents are the key evidence

blocks.zh: 風險導向計畫： 依產品性質、路線特性、季節因素設計差異化的運輸管控措施，而非一刀切
blocks.en: Risk-based planning: Design differentiated transport controls according to product nature, route characteristics and seasonal factors, rather than one-size-fits-all

blocks.zh: 容器選擇六因素： 產品要求 / 數量空間 / 外部溫度極值 / 最大運輸時間（含清關）/ 包裝 qualification 狀態 / 容器 validation 狀態
blocks.en: Six factors in container selection: product requirements / quantity and space / external temperature extremes / maximum transit time (including customs) / packaging qualification status / container validation status

blocks.zh: 冷媒管理三要點： 不得直接接觸產品 / 季節設定差異化 / 重複使用須完全重新冷凍並物理隔離凍結與冷藏冷媒
blocks.en: Three key points of coolant management: no direct contact with product / differentiated seasonal configurations / reused coolants must be completely re-frozen, with frozen and refrigerated coolants physically segregated

blocks.zh: 溫度 mapping： 溫控車輛需按季節進行，夏冬各一次（或覆蓋最壞情況）；設備需定期校正
blocks.en: Temperature mapping: temperature-controlled vehicles must be mapped by season, once in summer and once in winter (or covering the worst case); equipment must be calibrated regularly

blocks.zh: CDMO 出口重點： 中途轉運節點（機場、中轉倉）是最高風險環節，合約必須明確規定這些中間設施的溫控和安全要求
blocks.en: CDMO export focus: transit nodes (airports, transit warehouses) are the highest-risk stages, and the contract must clearly specify the temperature control and security requirements for these intermediate facilities
